detail.longDescription: 🐒 NEW: A study of 83 cases across 15 # chimpanzee and # bonobo communities finds that mothers carry deceased # infants for weeks, sometimes for up to four months. Those that died of # disease are carried longest, since the transition from life to # death is gradual.
